label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Minjee Lee Withdraws
items.text: Three-time major leader Minjee Lee withdrew midway through the second round of the 2026 Women’s Scottish Open due to injury or illness, casting doubt on her participation next week at the AIG Women’s British Open.

items.headline: DeChambeau Eyes Irish Open
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau expressed interest in playing the Irish Open at Trump International Doonbeg in September if it fits his schedule, following Rory McIlroy’s public welcome despite their rivalry.

items.headline: DeChambeau Praises LIV Fans
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau praised the enthusiastic crowds at LIV Golf UK ahead of Sunday’s final round, three shots behind leader Lucas Herbert at JCB Golf & Country Club.
